about: RBI draft 'Guidance on Regulatory Principles for Model Risk Management, 2026' (press release 2026-2027/528, 24 June 2026; comments were due 24 July 2026). A DRAFT: proposed expectations, not rules in force. Applies to commercial, small finance, payments, local area and regional rural banks, urban and rural co-operative banks, AIFIs, NBFCs, ARCs and credit information companies, for all models including third-party and AI/ML. Paragraph references and links to library controls only; the text is not reproduced.

controls.title: Human oversight with override, suspension and kill switch for models
controls.description: Human-in/on-the-loop oversight; override, suspension or deactivation including a kill switch; staff able to challenge and escalate; automation-bias risk considered.

controls.title: Complete model inventory; nothing used outside it; decommissioned models kept 10 years
controls.description: Inventory of active, inactive and decommissioned models with owners, developers, validators, approvers, tier, intended use and dependencies; no model used unless listed; decommissioned models retained at least ten years.

controls.title: Customer-facing AI discloses it is AI, states its limits, and offers a human
controls.description: Users are told they are interacting with an AI/ML system and its limitations, and can switch to human assistance on request.

controls.title: Third-party models: own accountability, independent validation, audit rights, exit
controls.description: The RE stays accountable for third-party model outcomes, validates them independently whatever the provider certifies, and contracts for audit rights, documentation, continuity and exit.

controls.title: Model change management: impact assessment, change log, re-validation past materiality
controls.description: Every model change has a documented impact assessment and a logged version and approval; a material change re-starts validation and approval.

controls.title: Model continuity: fallback when a model is unavailable or degrades; provider concentration
controls.description: Business continuity covers model unavailability or degradation with manual, substitute or back-up arrangements, and the risk of depending on few providers is managed.
